# Language Features

What the language itself has, the same in BlitzBasic, Blitz3D and BlitzPlus: control flow, functions, loops, types, keywords, math, strings, random numbers and time. Many of these are keywords the compiler understands by itself, the rest are commands. See also the [Language](Language) overview.

Back to [Home](Home) or the [Command Index](Command-Index).

* [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow) (9): Deciding what runs: If, Select and their parts.
* [Functions](Language-Features-Functions) (5): Declaring functions and jumping to labels with Goto and Gosub.
* [Keywords](Language-Features-Keywords) (6): Declaring variables and constants, including other files, and ending the program.
* [Loops](Language-Features-Loops) (10): Repeating code with For, While and Repeat.
* [Math](Language-Features-Math) (31): Trigonometry, rounding, bit functions and other numeric helpers.
* [Other](Language-Features-Other) (10): Program information, the environment, debugging and calling libraries.
* [Randomization](Language-Features-Randomization) (4): Random numbers and their seed.
* [Strings](Language-Features-Strings) (16): Searching, slicing, converting and formatting text.
* [Time & Date](Language-Features-Time-and-Date) (8): Clocks, the date, delays and timers.
* [Types](Language-Features-Types) (14): Integers, floats and strings, the short and long notation, and converting between them.
